description: Read-only setup status across your account, with the ids an integration needs: for each company its company_id and NIF, whether it can issue Live and exactly what is missing (issuing-readiness blockers, default series, VeriFactu, payment connection), its default series per document type (id and code), its VeriFactu status and its tax defaults, and the single recommended next action. A section that could not be read carries an `error` and never a default, so an unknown is never reported as ready.

company_id.description: Optional: restrict the report to a single company, by its company id (a UUID). This is not the NIF; the NIF is reported as a field of each company.

name: beel_get_setup_status

account.description: The authenticated account, or an error note if identity could not be read.

error.description: Why this section could not be read. Present only on failure.

company_id.description: The company id (a UUID), not the NIF.

defaults.description: The default series of each document type that has one: the series_id to send when issuing, and its code.

error.description: Why this section could not be read. Present only on failure.
Why this section could not be read. Present only on failure.

missing.description: Human-readable list of what is missing to issue Live.

error.description: Why this section could not be read. Present only on failure.

ready.description: Can issue Live (no blockers). `null` means readiness could not be read — see `error`; it does not mean not ready, and it does not mean ready.

tax_defaults.description: The tax configuration as stored, under the API field names. A prefill the API never applies to a line on its own: every NORMAL line still sends its main_tax. allowed_irpf_rates are the IRPF rates this NIF may bear.

error.description: Why this section could not be read. Present only on failure.
Why this section could not be read. Present only on failure.

status.description: VeriFactu state as the API derives it, e.g. ACTIVE or UNSIGNED.

environment.description: Which BeeL environment this session operates on. `live` means every invoice issued is a real fiscal document.

error.description: Why the report is incomplete: the company listing failed, a filter matched nothing, or entries were unusable. Present only when something went wrong.

next_action.description: Single recommended next action across the whole account.
